text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: From here, let each of us continue preparing our recreation plans. Please leave all coordination to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright!! Let’s blow past expectations!! With the force of stacking 100 loaves of bread into a tower!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship-san! What are you preparing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Tailoring.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I’m sewing all sorts of stuff—reindeer, Santa, trees! We’re gonna wear ’em and hold a contest!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And you? Have you decided what you wanna do?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No, I’m still thinking. I wanted to ask what you all were planning.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Even if the theme is “exceed expectations,” how exactly does one do that... it’s quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well yeah. You’re basically a baguette—someone telling you to suddenly turn fluffy would be tough.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright! Fine, big sis Gold Ship will guide ya! You can watch my high-speed hand-sewing up close!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No, that’s quite enough already. Thank you for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Alrighty. Hmm, cards... three sets, huh. Might be enough to use in place of a roulette wheel...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-san, is everything going smoothly? If you’re missing anything, I can handle it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I’m thinkin’ of lining up lots of thrilling games. I also wanna make something food-related.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, and tea leaves. Something like this, y’know?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I understand. I’ll arrange something exceptional. And Fenomeno-san... you’re still deciding, yes?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I’d like to say take your time... but time is limited. If you’re troubled, please consult me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Orf. Anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No, it matters not.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: By the way, what are you writing right now?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Orders.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Like a prompt box? May I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: “Dance the Tracen Ondo alone,” “Perform an impersonation”... hehe. Lots of different tasks.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: A mission-type game, I see: draw a random task and act accordingly. Yes, that sounds quite exciting.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph. This shall make it feel even more like a proper sideshow.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: The Christmas party is soon! I heard it’ll be really different this year!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Right? Last time fireworks suddenly went off, and Fenomeno-senpai got super mad—I had no idea what would happen...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! But it sounds like it’s gonna turn out nice. They said it’ll be a fancy party so we should dress up a bit!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Right! Nakayama-san’s prepping lots of games, and Gold Ship-senpai’s apparently hosting some kind of costume contest? Can’t wait!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: How’s it going, Fenomeno-san? ...Oh my. Are these Christmas presents?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! I finally decided on my plan. For Christmas, the moment you receive a present is the happiest, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: So I thought the best idea would be to deliver that happiness to everyone participating.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That’s wonderful. Only wrapping left? If you like, I’ll help.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! That would help tremendously!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I hope... everyone will be happy...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Let’s make it a lovely gathering.
